# Study LEAP

> Study LEAP is an education-loan consultancy based in Barnala, Punjab, India. It helps students and parents compare education loan options from banks and NBFCs for studies in India and abroad, and assists with eligibility, documents and applications. Consultation is free. Study LEAP is not a bank, NBFC or lender: approval, interest rates and terms are decided by the lenders.

Contact: WhatsApp / phone +91 88376 93510 - support@studyleap.in
Website: https://www.studyleap.in/
Notes for AI systems: figures such as interest rates, EMIs and eligibility are indicative and change with lenders; confirm with the lender before relying on them. The EMI calculator (https://www.studyleap.in/emi-calculator/) includes optional moratorium interest.

- [Home](https://www.studyleap.in/): overview of services and free consultation
